description: This file defines the SubscriptionPlan model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to retrieve subscription plan data from the database.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Model class for handling subscription plan data, including retrieval of individual and multiple plans, as well as total count.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves a single subscription plan record by its ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription plans, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscription plan records in the database.
